decisive_spans.text: diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter

response.rationale: Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus is strongly supported by the presence of progressive gait disturbance, imbalance, slow walking, repeated falls, and diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter. The absence of contrast enhancement further supports this diagnosis. Corticobasal Degeneration is contradicted by the absence of head tremor, and Frontotemporal Dementia is contradicted by the presence of diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter.
